subject: Re: Riverbed status: device-matrix decision ahead of the readout
body:
Team,

Decision ahead of Friday's latency readout, so the deck states it rather than debates it.

Device matrix for v1: the two smaller conv variants only. The large conv variant is cut from the smallest board — post-quantization it still sits at 496KB against the 512KB budget, and 16KB of headroom is not something I'll defend in a launch review. It stays in the matrix for the mid-tier board where it clears easily. The recurrent family ships nowhere in v1; it's accuracy-competitive but the state-management complexity Linnea hit is exactly the class of bug we don't want in a wake-word path.

Headline numbers for Nadia's packet: 14ms processing per 20ms chunk on-device, 0.1% of published accuracy, bit-exact streaming conversion. LRB slot requested for the Aug 6 board — window closes Aug 3 so all artifacts need to be in by then.

Priya
